{{Quote|I signed on to be your bodyguard. Seems to me you need me now more than ever.|Kal|<ref name="Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4">[[Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4|''Dark Times—A Spark Remains'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Kal''' was a muscular [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that served as a bodyguard to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]] following his acquisition of [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] on [[Kestavel]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Look at the size of him! ''And'' his bodyguards!|Meekerdin-maa|<ref name="Dark Times—A Spark Remains 2">[[Dark Times—A Spark Remains 2|''Dark Times—A Spark Remains'' 2]]</ref>}}
When [[Dass Jennir]], [[Beyghor Sahdett]], and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' arrived at the casino in search of Hudorra, Kal and his partner, [[Urtsk]], backed the already imposing [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] up, greatly intimidating [[Meekerdin-maa]]. When Sahdett [[Duel on Kestavel|betrayed]] Hudorra and Jennir, Kal was among the guards that surrounded the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Following the [[Sai tok/Legends|bisection]] of Urtsk and guardswoman [[Makall]], [[Bomo Greenbark]] utilized his [[Nosaurian flash]] ability, blinding the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]. Kal lunged at the former Jedi Master, but missed himself, [[Sun djem/Legends|losing]] his [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] to Sahdett's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Before he could be killed, however, the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] grabbed Kal's hip [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], distracting him long enough for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to defeat him.

He and Greenbark would then attempt to interrogate a bound Sahdett, but the Verpine refused to talk to them owing to their lack of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. Only after Hudorra and Jennir arrived did Sahdett explain his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] after being seduced by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

Later, when Hudorra tried to force his remaining staff to flee in advance of the upcoming [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack, Kal, along with [[Bryti]], [[Shaylai Veila]], [[Dayn]], and [[Nira]], reaffirmed their loyalty to the Jedi Master, refusing to abandon him. As such, Kal helped plan the [[Ambush at Kestavel|ambush]] on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], whom they assumed was coming to deal with the Jedi personally. Kal and Veila later helped seal the casino entranceway with [[Concrete/Legends|concrete]]. Kal sat at Hudorra's left side during a final feast, where the Bothan told everyone that only he and Jennir would be staying.

Later, as Vader and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] marched across the bridge to the casino, Kal was already aboard the ''Uhumele'' and caught the ziplining Greenbark, the last crewmember to evacuate. Kal would later be witness to Hudorra's final message, recorded on a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] given to Jennir by Bryti, wishing that [[May the Force be with you/Legends|the Force be with him]].
